s1.syndrome_frame: Chronic respiratory symptoms with systemic lymphadenopathy and multi-organ involvement
salient_findings: Difficulties in breathing, cough, and expectoration for more than 30 days
Multiple enlarged lymph nodes in the neck and abdomen regions
Cavities in the right upper anterior mediastinum and nodular shadow in the lower part of both lungs
Bilateral adrenal masses and bone destruction
key_facts: Presented with difficulties in breathing, cough, and expectoration
Past medical history of hyperuricemia for 5 years
Multiple enlarged lymph nodes in the neck and abdomen regions
Cavities in the right upper anterior mediastinum
Nodular shadow in the lower part of both lungs
Bone destruction of right clavicle and thoracic 11 right pedicle
Lymphadenopathy in neck and abdomen regions
Lesions in right lobe of thyroid gland

shortlist.label: Non-Hodgkin lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: Multiple enlarged lymph nodes, lymphadenopathy, and lesions in various organs

shortlist.label: Hodgkin lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: Cavities in the right upper anterior mediastinum and nodular shadow in the lungs

shortlist.label: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: Aggressive clinical presentation and elevated glucose metabolism in lesions

shortlist.label: Anaplastic large cell lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: Presence of large heterotypic proliferative lymphoid cells and systemic symptoms

raw.rationale: The patient's presentation of multiple enlarged lymph nodes, cavities in the mediastinum, nodular shadows in the lungs, and bilateral adrenal masses, along with the biopsy findings of proliferative lymphoid tissues and singular large heterotypic proliferative lymphoid cells, are consistent with Non-Hodgkin lymphoma.

rejected.label: Hodgkin lymphoma
rejected.why: The biopsy findings do not specifically mention the presence of Reed-Sternberg cells, which are characteristic of Hodgkin lymphoma.

rejected.label: Lymphomatoid granulomatosis
rejected.why: The patient's presentation and biopsy findings do not specifically suggest the presence of granulomatous inflammation, which is characteristic of Lymphomatoid granulomatosis.

rejected.label: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
rejected.why: While the patient's presentation is consistent with a type of Non-Hodgkin lymphoma, the specific subtype of Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma is not clearly indicated by the biopsy findings.

rejected.label: Anaplastic large cell lymphoma
rejected.why: The biopsy findings do not specifically mention the presence of anaplastic large cells, which are characteristic of Anaplastic large cell lymphoma.
